usedFor: Paymo holds your clients and projects and Orderry runs your service work, so “New Client” runs “Create Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Paymo, then “Create Client” in Orderry
bestTemplate.why: A client added in Paymo appears in Orderry too, so both systems start from the same list.

watchOut: Adding “Client Updated” to “Create Client” would add the same client again after every edit.
